title: No Sign of Weakness
overview: From the basements of the Parisian suburb Les Mureaux to the rings of Monaco, coach Abadila Hallab guides the destinies of young boxers seeking worldwide recognition through his teachings. He gets fired from the club during a toxic social climate towards immigrant population, he sticks to his quest by training those he calls his soldiers. His unwavering commitment to his “kids” mirrors a deeper, more personal fight: the lifelong pursuit of his father's admiration.
